integrity.evidence: Exact-integer dynamic-programming certificate for all 128 remaining-good states and all 448 state-action edges, with a standalone verifier; an analytic universal six-good lower bound.
integrity.status: Same-model scientific review only; no independent audit.

scientific_limitations: The seven-good witness certifies existence of a non-EF1 pure SPNE, not uniqueness or failure of every equilibrium.
The sharp universal lower bound holds for three agents with up to six goods and nonnegative monotone valuations; it is not a claim for other numbers of agents or noncyclic picking orders.
The exact finite certificate is not an exhaustive search over all valuation profiles.
Unindexed equivalent constructions may exist and require further independent literature examination.
title: Seven goods are the sharp online round-robin EF1 failure threshold for three agents
